svg.title: 12c File PR-2026-0087: Sourcing (quotation comparison)
svg.text: · sent 17 Sep to 4 prequalified ICT suppliers · closed Mon 28 Sep, 12:00

g.text: Busoga Tech Supplies has the best score and the lowest compliant price. Source Point ICT quoted less but offered a 1-year warranty against the 3 years required, so it was not scored. Nile Bridge Systems did not respond.
